assertions: crash during release.activate reconciled from the target receipt rather than replayed (operation owner)

crash before the verb, after the verb and inside the target between runtime switch and pointer commit: a successor attempt ends with the candidate active, the predecessor retained and exactly one pointer commit; the target's interrupted_activation intent is the reconciliation input (executor + fake target)
actual active release taken from the target owner's pointer; durable data untouched (no replay of completed effects)
limitations: package lane only: QEMU and real-VPS restart subsets are pending EXT-06 (disposable target lane) and EXT-01 (real VPS)
target-side fence refusal and activation intent are proven natively in internal/cloudtarget tests; the executor exercises them through a stateful fake target that mirrors the owner's JSON contract
target reboot itself is not simulated in the package lane; the crash-at-activation cases stand in until EXT-06 provides a disposable target
